def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    n=len(g); m=len(g[0])
    orange=[(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if g[r][c]==7]
    blues=[(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(m) if g[r][c]==2]
    axis=blues[0][1]
    rs=[r for r,c in orange]; cs=[c for r,c in orange]
    top,bottom=min(rs),max(rs)
    out=[[1]*m for _ in range(n)]
    direction=-1 if sum(r for r,c in blues)/len(blues)<top else 1
    dy=(top if direction==-1 else n-1-bottom)*direction
    left_cs=[c for r,c in orange if c<axis]
    right_cs=[c for r,c in orange if c>axis]
    dl=-min(left_cs) if left_cs else 0
    dr=m-1-max(right_cs) if right_cs else 0
    for r,c in orange:
        if c<axis: out[r+dy][c+dl]=7
        elif c>axis: out[r+dy][c+dr]=7
        else: out[r][c]=7
    for r,c in blues:
        rr=r
        while 0<=rr<n and out[rr][c]!=7:
            out[rr][c]=2
            rr-=direction
        # Also continue through gaps on the central axis until nearest central orange.
    return out
